sealed.statement: The seven Solver gates that cost a verifier round, an override or a parked declaration on 2026-09-05 are corrected: process quests declare the test-receipt probe by default, preflight --full reports a stale steering pack, quest lint and the attempt static gate enforce the epic planning bound, package.json demands model evidence only for model-checking changes, a standing candidate rejection waives the widen-scope theory demand, scope pressure ignores deletions and registered generated outputs, and comment-only runtime edits do not stamp runtime scope on a workflow quest.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

hypothesis: Seven Solver gates corrected with witnesses: solve new declares the test-receipt probe for process quests (--probe, --required-receipt) and quest lint warns on a harness under a non-receipt probe, the harness scaffold emits lint-clean code; preflight --full regenerates the steering pack in a scratch copy of the tracked files and names stale pack files without touching the tree; quest lint refuses an over-bound version-2 epic cited as links.planDoc and the attempt static gate names a changed epic over the bound, both through the ledger-consistency rule; package.json owes model evidence only when its diff touches a model-checking command; a standing candidate rejection waives the widen-scope theory demand at commit; scope-pressure admission ignores deleted files and registered generated outputs; a comment-only runtime diff section does not stamp runtime scope on a workflow quest; the start command's scaffold notice goes to stderr under --json.

hypothesis: Round-1 repair: isCommentOnlyDiffSection now strips comment text with a per-line scan that carries block-comment state across the changed lines and treats anything not provably comment as code (inline block comment before code, generator or doc-star lines outside a block, a close with no open block, a marker inside a string all refuse); the loop's declaration seal applies the plan-doc bound with the root while the rest of the seal lint stays root-free; witnesses added for the verifier's inputs.

findings.summary: F7 repair holds for every input the brief named and for the round-1 inputs (verifier-sf-r2/f7-probe.mjs, 32 cases, 0 unexpected): `/* istanbul ignore next */ throw ...`, `*items() {` -> `*items(filter) {`, `*/ process.exit(1);`, a `//` inside a string or template literal, `return 1; // trailing`, a star line outside a block, `*/` inside a string, a regex `/\/\//u`, nested `/* /* */ code`, `close */ /* reopen`, CRLF code, a comment change mixed with a code change, empty and binary sections are all refused; `/* // */`, a `//` inside an open block, `/** ... * x ... */`, nested `/* /* */` alone, CRLF comment lines, blank-only lines and a `\ No newline at end of file` marker are comment-only. Brief case 7 (a non-star code line inside an open block, [`+/*`, `+ code text`, `+*/`]) is accepted as comment text, which is correct JavaScript (it IS comment text) and not the fail-closed refusal the brief anticipated; harmless. A crafted diff carrying the same path in two sections (code in the first, a comment in the second) is admitted because diffSectionsByPath (line 380) keeps the last section per path; `git diff` never emits that shape, so it is a hand-authored-artifact concern only, noted for the repair. Red/green on the round-1 bytes: the round-1 change-artifact.js reconstructed from solve/changes/solver-friction-2026-09-06/attempt-1.diff.json (payload sha256 b42a1f65..., carries COMMENT_LINE_PREFIXES) applied to a git-archive export of 14df53ccc fails the candidate F7 witness at 'code after an inline block comment is code' (expected false, actual true); on the candidate the witness file passes 7/7.

The true round-1 to round-2 delta (attempt-1 applied to a base export, diffed against the worktree) is exactly the four declared paths and nothing else: change-artifact.js replaces COMMENT_LINE_PREFIXES with stripCommentText (lines 416-444) and the state-carrying loop in isCommentOnlyDiffSection; loop.js imports planDocErrors and ensureDeclared (lines 194-208) applies the plan-doc bound with the root before the root-free assertQuestReadyToSeal(quest); quest-lint.js exports planDocErrors (line 225) and assertQuestReadyToSeal takes options (line 254, lintQuest(quest, options)); the test file adds the 19 F7 assertion lines. Seal probe (verifier-sf-r2/seal-probe.mjs, runLoop on fixture roots with no docs/ directory): an over-bound v2 planDoc throws 'quest lint failed: epic big.md: version 2 exceeds the 150-line planning bound (lines=156) ...' and no quest-declared event is appended; an in-bound planDoc, a planDoc outside solve/epics, and a quest whose verificationTemplates name a category the fixture root cannot declare all seal (quest-declared appended), so fixture roots without steering templates still seal as claimed while lintQuest(quest, {root}) on the same quest would name the unknown template; that asymmetry is the stated design. Note (fail-closed, not a defect): ensureDeclared calls planDocErrors directly, so a LEGACY quest (no authoringContractVersion) with an over-bound planDoc is refused at the loop seal while lintQuest treats legacy quests as error-free (errors=[] legacy=true); `solve start` and `solve lint` therefore accept what `solve attempt/run` refuses for legacy quests. No caller besides loop.js and quest-lint.js uses assertQuestReadyToSeal. Circular-dependency ratchet 0/0; quest-lint.js still imports ledger-consistency.js one-way.
